definition: A function $f(x) = a^{x}$, where $a > 0$ and $a \ne 1$: the variable is in the power, so equal steps in $x$ multiply the output by the same factor.
A function $f(x) = \log_{a} x$, for $x > 0$, where $a > 0$ and $a \ne 1$; it is the inverse of $x \mapsto a^{x}$.
The logarithm with base $\mathrm{e}$, written $\ln x = \log_{\mathrm{e}} x$; it is the inverse of $\mathrm{e}^{x}$.
Interest that is added to an investment and then earns interest itself, so at a rate of $r$ per cent the value is multiplied by $1 + \frac{r}{100}$ each period.
A loss of value over time; at a rate of $r$ per cent a year the value is multiplied by $1 - \frac{r}{100}$ each year.
